description:
A diff with no hunks does not strand its placeholder. The test seeds a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} with two identical patch turns; the second one's diff is a no-op with no hunks, so it renders nothing. "The second diff host" is the second element matching ".patch-tool-diff-host" (document.querySelectorAll(".patch-tool-diff-host")[1]); it is zero-height, so wait for it to exist, not to be visible. Wait with evals that have "expect" and a timeout, not with polling loops inside the expression. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait until the second diff host exists (allow 30s).
2. Wait until the second diff host's style.minHeight is empty, i.e. (host.style.minHeight || "-") is exactly "-" (allow 15s): the placeholder was released.
3. Then the diff must really have hydrated and rendered nothing: for the second diff host's "diffs-container" element, JSON.stringify({hydrated: !!container?.shadowRoot, renderedDiff: !!container?.shadowRoot?.querySelector("pre")}) must be exactly {"hydrated":true,"renderedDiff":false}.

steps.expression: (() => { const host = document.querySelectorAll('.patch-tool-diff-host')[1]; const container = host?.querySelector('diffs-container'); return JSON.stringify({hydrated: !!container?.shadowRoot, renderedDiff: !!container?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('pre')}); })()
